answer_1.quote: we aim to investigate whether smaller summarization models can be substantially improved with better references. To this end, we study an LLM-as-reference distillation setting... Specifically, we employ LLMs in the training of smaller text summarization models...

answer_2.quote: For reference-based evaluation, we report the ROUGE-1/2 F1 scores between the system outputs and the reference summaries... For reference-free evaluation, we use either GPTScore or GPTRank...

answer_3.quote: We focus on two recent LLM-based evaluation methods: GPTScore and an extended version of G-Eval, which we coin GPTRank... we use GPTRank with aspect-specific prompts...

answer_4.quote: We use Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) for the crowd-annotation collection... we (the co-authors) conducted a careful expert evaluation...
answer_4.guideline: Pairwise comparison on three aspects: (1) salience, (2) coherence, and (3) overall preference/quality
